all.text: Varchild, the Kjeldoran general, performs countless raids on Balduvia, leaving only a handful of survivors, while she and King Darien trade missives over the carrier pigeons.
She vows that her truth is stronger than any legion's swords, and Darien laments that too many of the missing dead are turning up in her ranks.
Lovisa says the Order of Stromgald spreads its lies from within Varchild's troops, yet Varchild dismisses the Order as lost and calls for Balduvia to burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth.
Darien says she would rather draw the maps of the new Kjeldor in Balduvian blood than have peace, while Jodah and Jaya warn Kjeld and the Knights of Stromgald's coup fails.
